description.value: % Arabica is an internationally recognized specialty coffee brand with a striking Whistler Village location designed around the theme of ice caves, featuring white metal mesh domes suspended across the ceiling. The counter is positioned centrally for clear sightlines from the entrance, creating an open, welcoming atmosphere suited to all weather conditions. It is part of a global network of architecturally distinctive cafés known for high-quality coffee sourced from around the world.
